chapters.title: Nehemiah's prayer
chapters.summary: In the Persian palace, Nehemiah hears that Jerusalem's walls lie broken. He weeps, fasts and prays, confessing Israel's sin and asking God for favor with the king.

chapters.title: Nehemiah inspects the walls
chapters.summary: The king grants Nehemiah's request to rebuild Jerusalem. He inspects the ruined walls at night and rallies the people: let us rise up and build.

chapters.title: Building the wall
chapters.summary: Families and groups each rebuild a section of the wall and gates, from priests to goldsmiths to perfume makers.

chapters.title: Building and guarding
chapters.summary: Enemies mock and plot to attack. The builders pray and post guards, working with a tool in one hand and a weapon in the other.

chapters.title: Justice for the poor
chapters.summary: Poor families are losing land and children to debt. Nehemiah confronts the nobles, who agree to stop charging interest and return property.

chapters.title: The wall finished
chapters.summary: Enemies try trickery and threats to stop Nehemiah, but he refuses to stop. The wall is finished in fifty-two days, and the nations see it was done by God.

chapters.title: The returned exiles listed
chapters.summary: Nehemiah appoints gatekeepers and leaders, and finds the record of the families who first returned from exile.

chapters.title: Ezra reads the law
chapters.summary: The people gather and Ezra reads the law aloud while the Levites explain it. The people weep, but are told the joy of the Lord is their strength.

chapters.title: A prayer of confession
chapters.summary: The people fast and confess. The Levites pray through Israel's history, praising God's faithfulness and mercy despite generations of rebellion.

chapters.title: A binding agreement
chapters.summary: The leaders, priests and people sign an agreement to keep God's law, observe the Sabbath and support the temple.

chapters.title: Resettling Jerusalem
chapters.summary: One in ten families is chosen by lot to live in Jerusalem, and the people bless those who volunteer.

chapters.title: Dedicating the wall
chapters.summary: Two great choirs march around the wall in thanksgiving, and the joy of Jerusalem is heard far away.

chapters.title: Nehemiah's final reforms
chapters.summary: Returning after an absence, Nehemiah throws out Tobiah, restores support for the Levites, enforces the Sabbath, and asks God to remember him for good.
